photo_estimates_not_verified.basis: Top-down seller photo scaled by labeled 31 x 25 mm board outline; no tolerance drawing.

proposed_keepouts_not_part_dimensions.note: Provisional service-space allocations, NOT a verified upper bound or fit guarantee; connector model, stack height and bend radius still need validation.

unknown: nav stem width, shape and exposed height
nav.mounting_advice: Use adjustable or replaceable carrier; do not freeze case boss centers from photography. Carry wire strain relief on carrier, not switch stem.

unknown: fit of proposed printed adapter onto Amazon stem
cap.note: Compatibility is with Sprintek stem sizes, not Amazon nav module. Keep cap above bezel with adequate lateral travel; outer-cap sizing in visual must remain labeled provisional.

back_mark.keepout_note: Design allocation includes carrier, legs and solder space, excludes printed user key and its guide. 4.3 + 3.5 = 7.8 mm nominal switch tip-to-leg-tip; carrier sits inside leg span, do not double-count full board thickness.
back_mark.mechanics: Guide the printed key vertically, give it a retaining flange and a separately set travel stop; no preload at rest. Nominal pretravel is not the same as an allowable bottomed-out design travel.
